roads.name: Ron Smith Memorial Highway
words: Sweeping and steady: 17 curves in 3.6 miles.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 720 to 753 ft, with 275 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 30 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.26 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Clarksville Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 15 curves in 3.5 miles.
Tight and technical: most curves turn on a radius under 130 ft.
From 688 to 753 ft, with 335 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 2.77 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Moraine View Park Road
words: Curve after curve after curve: 28 in 3.0 miles, about 10 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 823 to 859 ft, with 251 ft of up and down along the way.
